notes: Read-only compilation: 65 observations, including 52 reported material sets and 13 PBDB aliases; 109 interpretations. All 114 supplied PBDB rows are accounted for: 18 retained through aliases and 96 excluded. Canonical observations carry alternatives; database aliases mirror their main reading and inherit alternatives through same_material_as. Apply temporal cutoffs separately from counts_for, which denotes character evidence and therefore remains populated for securely identified but redated Devonian material. Several regional compilation records lack recoverable locality/horizon detail and are explicitly not independent sampling units. Modern-root and Permian-root rejections retain host-rock stages because the supplied timescale cannot encode their actual ages. The 1979 full text resolves Capel Horeb as the 1976 tracheid locality and explicitly distinguishes sterile vascular axes from fertile Cooksonia. Ordos and Piterophyton retain their unassessed positive claims; neither is an independently confirmed calibration. Q1/Q5 follow-up priorities are those Ordovician claims, Kazakh tracheid anatomy, eastern Yea dating, and specimen-level locality recovery. Global completeness remains limited by inaccessible originals and unresolved compilation provenance. Blank DOI fields mean no qualifying Crossref verification was established; the one populated DOI was checked against the repository's Crossref results. Source access describes known availability, not the checked level. Bibliographic discrepancies and unrecovered pagination are explicit. No files were edited, including closed-literature or questions registers. Stage vocabulary, one-main-per-observation structure, source links and exhaustive PBDB partition were checked in memory; 69 repository quotation instances in the working extraction passed exact-substring checks. Memory supplied project orientation only; factual evidence came from current files and source excerpts.
